name: Decloid Chaos: Overcharged [BETA]
desc:
Welcome To Decloid's Chaos! a game developed by PSK Games 

Protect The Core, Don't let Meiron-Code Fall! 
Use Different strategies to reach the wave 24 
Play and organize yourself with friends! 
Play and Get Points to buy Classes! These classes give you different abilities, combine classes with your friends to make a strategy! 
Level up by playing as you earn XP! 

This game is Beta, so expect bugs and glitches, you can report it on our Community Server!
